## Research

**Detecting Evasive Answers in Political Interviews** · *Oct 2025 – Jun 2026*  
SemEval-2026 Task 6, research project in the Project R course, FER · Zagreb, Croatia

- Compared flat, hierarchical and multitask RoBERTa models, with the hierarchical model performing best.
- Found that multitask models broke the label hierarchy, and enforcing it at inference raised F1.

## Projects

**Personal Language Model** · PyTorch, QLoRA, mlx-lm · [GitHub](https://github.com/ma55530/LLM-from-scratch)

- Built a training set from my own WhatsApp and Instagram messages.
- Pre-trained a GPT-style model from scratch, then QLoRA fine-tuned Ministral-8B to write in my style.

**Dobby: Movie & TV Recommendation Platform** · PyTorch, pgvector · [GitHub](https://github.com/ma55530/Dobby)

- Led a 7-person team building a social platform for rating, tracking and recommending films and shows.
- Built a hybrid recommender combining PyTorch matrix factorization with genre embeddings on 23.6M ratings.
- Solved user cold start by mapping genre picks into the embedding space, with pgvector and fuzzy-logic ranking.

**Last Translation Benchmark** · contributor · [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04173)

- Wrote EN–HR cases using dialects, false friends and numerals that break 8+ of 10 top MT systems.
